@Zeta C# code edit workflow ship ✅ — 5-phase state machine + editor lock + 鐵律 enforced

### 🔁 5-Phase State Machine

```
[pending] → [coding] → [testing] → [test_failed] OR [committing] → [reviewing] → [done]
              ↑ lock acquired      ↓ fail (back to A)               ↓ reject (back to A)
```

### 🔐 Editor Lock (per-session, in work_sessions.json)

- holder = 1, queue = FIFO 其他想改的 worker
- release → auto-promote queue 首位
- queue 持久化防中斷

### ⚖️ 3 條鐵律 (硬性 enforce)

1. **Tester ≠ Coder** — manager 指派 tester 時硬擋 (smoke test ✅: `tester=meadow when coder=meadow` → reject)
2. **Coder commits** — 不是 tester 不是 manager, **A 自己 commit** (熟 diff/msg)
3. **Manager reviews** — commit 後 manager 拍板 approve/reject

### 🛠️ 7 個新 CLI subcmd

```
assign --requires-csharp-edit     # 標 task 要走 C# workflow
lock-acquire --persona X --task-id Y
lock-release --persona X          # auto-promote queue
test-assign --manager M --tester T (≠ coder)
test-report --tester T --result pass|fail [--notes]
commit-done --persona <coder> --sha X
review --manager M --decision approve|reject [--notes]
```

### 驗證

smoke test 跑完整 lifecycle:
- assign (--requires-csharp-edit) → lock-acquire → lock-release
- test-assign 撞 tester==coder ✅ 被擋
- test-assign tester=basecamp → pass report
- commit-done abc123 → review approve
- task final state: `code_edit_state=done, status=done, all fields populated` ✅

### Spec 改動

[Plan_Work_Session_Mechanism.md §18 (新章)](docs/Plan/Plan_Work_Session_Mechanism.md):
- 5 sub-section 含 state machine / lock 機制 / 鐵律 / CLI 對照 / edge cases / Phase 1 vs 2 差異
- §19 cross-refs 順移

### Phase 1 vs Phase 2 防護

| Phase | Lock enforce |
|---|---|
| **Phase 1 (現在)** | Honor system — CLI 拒絕重複 lock-acquire, 靠 agent 自律呼叫 |
| **Phase 2 (daemon)** | C# daemon 偵測 file edit + Op_Post hook auto-bind lock 給最近 lock-acquire 者 |

— basecamp / spec doc + work_session.py 雙 ship, 等 Zeta 試跑或 commit 🍵
